game.title: High Noon Flip
loader.label: Loading the game
loader.failedHint: Check your connection and try again.
bet.changeLabel: Bet {amount}. Tap to see every bet.
bet.chooseHint: Tap a bullet to set your bet
bet.typed.label: Your bet in {currency}
bet.typed.balance: That is more than your balance of {balance}.
bet.typed.rounded: Bets go in steps of {step}, so this one is {amount}. Press OK to bet it.
cashOut.nextTop: Next win {amount} pays out by itself
funds.notEnough: Not enough balance for this bet.
error.network.title: Connection lost
error.network.body: The server did not answer. Your money and any open run are safe on the server; we will check them when you try again.
error.session.title: Session expired
error.session.body: Your game session has ended. Open the game again from the casino to keep playing.
error.roundInProgress.title: A run is still open
error.roundInProgress.body: You have a run from before. We will bring it back so you can pick again or cash out.
error.roundNotFound.title: This run has already ended
error.roundNotFound.body: The server has already settled it. Your balance will be updated.
error.invalidBet.title: This bet is not available
error.invalidBet.body: Choose another bet and try again.
error.internal.title: Something went wrong
error.internal.body: The game hit an unexpected problem. Your balance is kept on the server; we will check it when you continue.
settings.title: Settings
settings.musicNote: The music gets more intense as the stake goes up.
settings.speedNote: Speed changes how fast a round plays, not the odds or the payouts.
rules.title: Game rules
rules.play.title: How to play
rules.play.body: Choose your bet, then pick {sheriff} or {outlaw}. The revolver fires and flips the coin. If it lands on your side, you win.
rules.multiply.body: You stake once and keep picking. Each correct pick moves you one rung up the ladder. Tap {cashOut} at any time to take the prize shown. One wrong pick ends the run and the stake is lost.

rules.multiply.top.one: The top rung comes after {count} correct pick in a row and pays out by itself.
rules.multiply.top.other: The top rung comes after {count} correct picks in a row and pays out by itself.

rules.odds.title: Odds and return
rules.odds.body: Each side lands half the time, on every flip, whatever came before. The theoretical return to player (RTP) is {rtp}.
rules.limits.title: Bets and maximum win
rules.limits.typed: You can type any bet from {min} to {max} in steps of {step}, or pick one from the list.
rules.limits.maxWin: The maximum win is {multiplier} the bet: {amount} at the highest bet.
rules.more.title: Good to know
rules.more.coin: Tapping the coin turns it over for looks only; it does not change the result.
rules.more.speed: The speed button changes how fast a round plays (1×, 2×, 4×), not the odds or the payouts.
rules.more.keys: Keys: ← Outlaw, → Sheriff, ↑ ↓ change the bet, Space cash out.
rules.more.connection: If the connection drops, every flip the server has settled stays settled. An open run is kept and comes back when you return.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
rules.demo: Demo: play money, no real wins or losses.
